summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K containing a Stock Exchange Announcement dated July 31, 2026, reporting PDMR share transactions. A non-executive director acquired 867 ordinary shares at £1.21345 per share under a dividend reinvestment plan, totaling £1,052.06, transacted on July 30, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine insider shareholding notification under MAR, not a special situation.
